Form.Introduction: Welcome to the application. You’ll complete five guided steps to enter information and upload supporting documentation, with validation along the way to help prevent issues. At the end, you’ll review a full summary before submitting.

Steps.Name: Applicant Information
Steps.Description: Collect the applicant’s basic identifying information, primary contacts, and communication details. This establishes who is submitting the application and how the agency can follow up if clarification is needed.

Properties.Label: Purpose
Properties.Description: A description of the purpose of the project that has been awarded under the grant program. This comes from the Federal Integrated Business Framework (FIBF) model.

Steps.Name: Eligibility & Program Selection
Steps.Description: Confirm eligibility requirements and identify the appropriate program, category, or funding opportunity based on responses. This step ensures applicants are routed correctly and helps prevent submissions that do not meet baseline criteria.

Actions.Name: Eligibility & Program Selection - Field Input - Type of Application (Child Application)

Properties.Label: Type of Application
Properties.Description: The type of application that should be applied (e.g., new, continuation, revision). If "New", the application is being submitted for the first time. If "Continuation", an extension is required for an additional funding/budget period for a project with a projected completion date. This can include renewals. If "Revision", a change in the Federal government's financial obligation or contingent liability from an existing obligation has occurred.

Actions.Name: Primary Record - All Controls - Field Input - Approved Cost Share or Match (Child Application)

Properties.Label: Approved Cost Share or Match
Properties.Description: An amount of approved cost sharing or matching, where applicable. This comes from the Federal Integrated Business Framework (FIBF) model.

Actions.Name: Primary Record - All Controls - Field Input - Approved Indirect Cost Rate (Child Application)

Properties.Label: Approved Indirect Cost Rate
Properties.Description: The approved percentage for the indirect cost rate based on the calculation of the "Total Approved Indirect Budget" over the "Total Approved Direct Budget".

Actions.Name: Primary Record - All Controls - Field Input - Risk Indicator (Child Application)

Properties.Label: Risk Indicator
Properties.Description: A score that represents the risk level associated with this application and submitter. This is auto calculated based on the risk assessment configured by a Program Manager on the related funding opportunity. The higher the number, the greater the risk.

Actions.Name: Primary Record - All Controls - Field Input - Fully Disbursed (Child Application)

Properties.Label: Fully Disbursed
Properties.Description: The indication of whether the application has been fully disbursed or not.

Actions.Name: Primary Record - All Controls - Field Input - Areas Impacted (Child Application)

Properties.Label: Areas Impacted
Properties.Description: A list of geographic areas or entities aided within the function or activity for a Federal award using categories specified in the Federal agency instructions (e.g., Cities, Counties, States). This comes from the Federal Integrated Business Framework (FIBF) model.

Steps.Name: Project or Request Details
Steps.Description: Capture the substantive information required for review, including the purpose, scope, timeline, and key details of the request. Structured questions support consistent evaluation and reduce the need for follow-up.

ChildFormSteps.Name: Information
ChildFormSteps.Description: Capture and manage the core details for each proposed project associated with this application. Use this table to add, review, and update project entries such as title, location, period of performance, objectives, and key milestones. Each row represents a single project record that will be included in the final application package and used during federal review.

Properties.Description: The anticipated date the project work will begin, if awarded.

Actions.Name: Information - Field Input - Proposed End Date

Properties.Label: Proposed End Date
Properties.Description: The anticipated date the project work will be completed.

Actions.Name: Information - Field Input - Congressional Districts of Program/Project (Project)

Properties.Label: Congressional Districts of Program/Project
Properties.Description: The U.S. congressional district where the project will be performed (e.g., IL-07).

Actions.Name: Information - Field Input - Description (Project)

Properties.Label: Description
Properties.Description: The main description of this record that provides a brief, description of the project.

Steps.Name: Standard Form 424
Steps.Description: Complete the SF-424 to provide the official federal application header information used for intake and tracking. This includes key applicant identifiers, the funding opportunity information, and high-level request details required for initial acceptance. The form ensures the submission aligns with federal standards and contains the baseline data needed to begin review.

Actions.Name: SF424 - Field Input - Attestation

Properties.Label: Attestation
Properties.Description: The attestation required to be confirmed in order to submit the form.

Actions.Name: Standard Form 424 - Field Input - Estimated Funding: Applicant

Properties.Label: Estimated Funding: Applicant
Properties.Description: The estimated amount to be requested, or to be contributed during the first funding/budget period by an applicant contributor.

Actions.Name: Standard Form 424 - Field Input - Estimated Funding: Other

Properties.Label: Estimated Funding: Other
Properties.Description: The estimated amount to be requested, or to be contributed during the first funding/budget period by an other contributor.

Actions.Name: Standard Form 424 - Field Input - Organizational Affiliation

Properties.Label: Organizational Affiliation
Properties.Description: Identify any affiliated organization relevant to this application (e.g., parent organization, partner, or sponsoring entity), if applicable.

Actions.Name: Standard Form 424 - Field Input - Child Secondary Report (Standard Form 424)

Properties.Label: Polymorphic Field (Secondary Reports)
Properties.Description: Test field for demonstration polymorphic lookup capabilities.

Steps.Name: Standard Form 425
Steps.Description: Complete the SF-425 to report financial information in the standardized federal format. This section captures required financial figures and supporting details that enable consistent review, monitoring, and audit readiness. Validations help ensure totals align and required fields are provided before submission.

Steps.Name: Review, Certifications & Submit
Steps.Description: Provide a complete summary of all entered information and uploaded files for confirmation. Applicants attest to required certifications and acknowledgements, then submit the finalized package for agency review.

Actions.Name: Review, Certifications & Submit - Field Input - Submission Type (Child Application)

Properties.Label: Submission Type
Properties.Description: A code denoting the type of grant application submitted, e.g., initial application for a Federal award, pre-application, or revised application for a Federal award. This comes from the Federal Integrated Business Framework (FIBF) model.

Actions.Name: Review, Certifications & Submit - Document Upload - AdditionalDocuments

Properties.Description: Upload any supplemental documents needed to support the application (e.g., narratives, letters of support, certifications, or other requested materials).

eyfrcc_childapplicationtest.EntityDescription: This table represents the template "child" application table for all child application tables created through the Application Builder. Fields, forms, views, and more will be included by default for all newly created child tables through the Application Builder publishing process.

eyfrcc_subrecipient.EntityDescription: A subapplicant is a non-Federal entity that is invited to apply for a subaward from a pass-through entity to carry out part of a Federal program.

eyfrcc_project.EntityDescription: A planned set of activities or services that the applicant will carry out using the funding, designed to address a specific need or goal in the community.

eyfrcc_standardform424a.EntityDescription: The Standard Form 424A (SF-424A) is used to budget and request grant funds for non-construction programs. It is part of the broader Standard Form 424 Form Family of government-wide standard data sets.

eyfrcc_standardform424.EntityDescription: The Standard Form 424 (SF-424) is used in all federal grant applications and collects information including type of submission, applicant information, type of applicant, and proposed project dates. It is part of the broader Standard Forms 424 Form Family of government-wide standard data sets.

eyfrcc_standardform425.EntityDescription: The Standard Form 425 (SF-425) is used by recipients to submit reports on their grant's financial progress. It is part of the broader Form Family of government-wide standard data sets.

eyfrcc_expenditure.EntityDescription: An expenditure represents the amount of money paid out or is spent. These are reported by a recipient relating to their award.

eyfrcc_form.EntityDescription: A form represents a user interface that users can use to create data and/or interact with data that is relevant to them. This can be used to create application and report forms, review checklists, and review process flows.

eyfrcc_applicationtype.EntityDescription: A funding opportunity represents the official availability of funding through a program. Each opportunity has an overview of eligibility criteria, required documentation, the application process, and award details. An application form is built in order to allow an external user to apply for funding.

contact.EntityDescription: Person with whom a business unit has a relationship, such as customer, supplier, and colleague.

eyfrcc_fiscalyear.EntityDescription: A fiscal year is used in accounting and for budget purposes. It is used to help perform financial reporting on important, key dates used throughout the system.

eyfrcc_appeal.EntityDescription: An appeal is a request that an applicant can submit in order to challenge the decision made on their application or report.

eyfrcc_expenditurereport.EntityDescription: Represents a formal submission by a grant recipient detailing how funds disbursed under an award have been spent. Each Expenditure Report groups one or more individual Expenditure records and includes key reporting metadata, such as the reporting period, submission date, total amount reported, and approval status. This table provides an auditable record of recipient financial reporting, supporting traceability from obligated funds to actual expenditures.

eyfrcc_indirectcostrate.EntityDescription: A table used to capture the negotiated indirect cost rate agreement (NICRA) information associated with an organization.

eyfrcc_loanmodification.EntityDescription: A loan modification represents a request submitted from an applicant in order to modify their loan application. Multiple modification requests can be submitted over the lifecycle of the application in the event that the applicant requires a change.

eyfrcc_matchrelief.EntityDescription: Requests submitted by grant applicants/ recipients to reduce or waive their required non-federal cost share (match) contribution due to financial hardship, extenuating circumstances, or other justifiable reasons. The request typically includes supporting documentation and justification, and is subject to review and approval by the grantor in accordance with program regulations and policy.

eyfrcc_modification.EntityDescription: A grant modification represents a request submitted from an applicant in order to modify their grant application. Multiple modification requests can be submitted over the lifecycle of the application in the event that the applicant requires a change.

eyfrcc_monitoring.EntityDescription: Monitoring captures a type of desk review conducted on a selected recipient that could involve a summary of the results and observations around compliance, financials, and performance.

eyfrcc_paymentrequest.EntityDescription: A disbursement request captures the specific request from a borrower or grantee that they would like to receive a disbursement from their award, if it hasn't been disbursed in full.

eyfrcc_performancereport.EntityDescription: A table to capture post-award performance reports; these are data-driven reports used to measure progress against specific performance indicators, objectives, or outcome metrics as defined in the grant agreement or Notice of Award. Performance reports typically include quantitative data, KPIs, and analysis to assess whether the project is meeting its intended impact. These are often required annually or at the end of the period of performance.

eyfrcc_profilereport.EntityDescription: A profile report is a type of report that an external user in the portal has uploaded on their profile page.

eyfrcc_progressreport.EntityDescription: A table to capture grantee Progress Reports, narrative-focused reports submitted by the recipient to describe milestones achieved, activities conducted, and updates on the overall progress of the grant project. Progress reports emphasize implementation status, timeline adherence, challenges encountered, and plans for the next reporting period. Reports are often submitted quarterly or semi-annually, and may precede a more formal performance evaluation.

eyfrcc_indirectcostratelines.EntityDescription: A table used to capture the indirect cost rates associated with a particular Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement (NICRA). An indirect cost rate is the ratio between the total indirect expenses and some direct cost base.
